messages:
maria (Security): Auditor asked for a compact artifact tying a service-account RBAC change to KMS decrypt events and deploys. They want timestamps, request IDs, and a hashable bundle. Can we produce this by EOD?
alan (Infra): yep, we can export RBAC change events + CloudTrail/KMS logs + deploy trace. how granular does the auditor need the timestamps? second or ms?
auditor_jones: seconds is fine but prefer iso8601 with timezone. need correlation keys: service_account, role_binding_id, user_who_changed, kms_key_id, kms_decrypt_request_id, and deployment_id. also a short narrative that maps controls to SOC2 CC6/CC7.
jen (SRE): for deploy correlation we can pull CI run id and the k8s rollout event. we have tracing in jaeger for the deploy path; can export traces for the job id.
maria (Security): good. alan — can you run the export and put a signed manifest in s3 with a sha256? auditor prefers checksums.
alan (Infra): starting export now. will run two queries: one for iam/rbac change events, one for KMS decrypts, one for CI/deploy. will join by service_account and time window. sample splunk/s3 query i plan to run: ```splunk
index=infra_logs source=cloudtrail eventName=PutRolePolicy OR eventName=UpdateRole
| table _time, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.roleName, requestID
``` and ```splunk
index=security_logs source=kms action=Decrypt
| table _time, requestID, keyId, principalId, ciphertextBlobHash
```
ops-bot: log-export triggered by alan: export-id=exp-20260322-7b9f; estimated size 24MB; destination=s3://redwood-audit-exports/exp-20260322-7b9f.tar.gz
alan (Infra): upload done. created manifest at s3://redwood-audit-exports/exp-20260322-7b9f/manifest.json (sha256: 3b7a9f...f2c). also attached a small mapping csv with event join keys.
auditor_jones: thanks. please include the query text, the time window used, and the person who ran it. last thing: can you redact any unrelated customer IDs before we hand over? PII minimization required.
jen (SRE): we'll run a scrub script that strips customer identifiers and leaves service_account and internal ids. sample scrub command: ```bash
python tools/scrub_logs.py --input export.ndjson --redact-pii --keep-fields service_account,requestID,keyId
```
maria (Security): I'll prepare the control mapping doc: link controls -> exported fields (e.g., "PutRolePolicy" -> evidence: requestID, userIdentity, change diff). will add narrative for SOC2 and ISO mapping.
auditor_jones: once you upload the sanitized bundle, please DM me the presigned link and include expected retention window. auditor needs to confirm chain-of-custody.
alan (Infra): presigned link created, 7 days expiry: https://s3-presigned.example/exp-20260322-7b9f.tar.gz?sig=XXX
maria (Security): packaging notes and control mapping uploaded to the manifest folder. tagging @legal for any extra redaction signoff.
ops-bot: manual audit export completed by alan at 2026-03-22T14:03:10Z, export-id=exp-20260322-7b9f, checksum=sha256:3b7a9f...f2c.
jen (SRE): quick followup — we also captured KMS key rotation events and service-account last-used timestamps in the bundle as requested.
auditor_jones: received, will review and follow up if sample traces needed. thanks for quick turnaround. :thumbsup: 
maria (Security): thanks team — I'll record this artifact in the SOC2 evidence tracker and link to the manifest. filing ticket for retention policy check.
